# Tables

Structured rows and columns for displaying and interacting with data. Includes sortable and filterable header cells, row selection (with select-all + indeterminate state), six body cell types (text, link, status, tag, action, checkbox), striped and bordered variants, three densities, and full RTL support. Modeled on Figma frames 5698:40875 (Table), 5898:27389 (Header), 5698:40844 (Row).

**Stylesheet:** `components/tables/tables.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for composing tables.

| Class | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.table-wrapper` | CSS class | Container providing the rounded outer border and horizontal scroll on overflow. |
| `.table` | CSS class | Applied to the <table> element. Sets typography, collapse mode, and base spacing. |
| `.table--compact` | CSS class | Tighter cell padding (4px × 12px) for dense layouts. |
| `.table--relaxed` | CSS class | Roomier cell padding (16px × 24px). |
| `.table--striped` | CSS class | Alternate row background tint. |
| `.table--bordered` | CSS class | Adds vertical borders between columns in addition to the row dividers. |
| `.table__cell--link` | CSS class on <td> | Link-styled cell (Saudi green text, underline on hover). |
| `.table__cell--text` | CSS class on <td> | Plain body text cell. Default styling — class is optional and exists for clarity. |
| `.table__cell--action` | CSS class on <td>/<th> | Narrow column holding a single icon button. |
| `.table__cell--checkbox` | CSS class on <td>/<th> | Narrow leading column for the selection checkbox. |
| `.table__checkbox` | CSS class on <input type="checkbox"> | Styled checkbox used for both select-all and per-row selection. Supports :indeterminate. |
| `.table__sort` | CSS class on <button> inside <th> | Sortable header. Set data-sort="asc" or "desc" to display the active arrow. |
| `.table__sort-icon` | CSS class | Decorative element rendering the up/down arrows. Place inside .table__sort. |
| `.table__filter` | CSS class on <button> | Filter button (funnel icon). Use aria-pressed="true" for the active/filtered state. |
| `.table__action` | CSS class on <button> | Generic icon button used in row action cells. Arrow auto-flips in RTL. |
| .is-selected / aria-selected="true" | State on <tr> | Highlights a selected row using the primary-light token. |

## Basic Table

The minimum composition: a .table-wrapper around a <table class="table"> with a header row and body rows.

| Name | Role | Team | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sara Al-Otaibi | Admin | Platform | Active |
| Khalid Al-Subaie | Editor | Content | Pending |
| Maya Hassan | Reviewer | QA | Active |

```html
<div style="width: 100%;">
    <div class="table-wrapper">
        <table class="table">
            <thead>
                <tr><th>Name</th><th>Role</th><th>Team</th><th>Status</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                <tr><td class="table__cell--link">Sara Al-Otaibi</td><td>Admin</td><td>Platform</td><td><span class="status-tag status-tag--sm status-tag--subtle status-tag--success"><span class="status-tag__dot"></span><span class="status-tag__label">Active</span></span></td></tr>
                <tr><td class="table__cell--link">Khalid Al-Subaie</td><td>Editor</td><td>Content</td><td><span class="status-tag status-tag--sm status-tag--subtle status-tag--warning"><span class="status-tag__dot"></span><span class="status-tag__label">Pending</span></span></td></tr>
                <tr><td class="table__cell--link">Maya Hassan</td><td>Reviewer</td><td>QA</td><td><span class="status-tag status-tag--sm status-tag--subtle status-tag--success"><span class="status-tag__dot"></span><span class="status-tag__label">Active</span></span></td></tr>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Header Cell Types

The four header cell flavors: plain text, sortable (click to cycle), filter (toggleable funnel), and select-all checkbox.

|  | Plain header | Sortable | Active ASC | Active DESC |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | — | — | — | — | — |

```html
<div style="width: 100%;" data-table-interactive="">
    <div class="table-wrapper">
        <table class="table">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th class="table__cell--checkbox"><input type="checkbox" class="table__checkbox" data-role="select-all" aria-label="Select all"></th>
                    <th>Plain header</th>
                    <th><button type="button" class="table__sort" data-sort=""><span>Sortable
                            </span><span class="table__sort-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                    <th><button type="button" class="table__sort" data-sort="asc"><span>Active ASC
                            </span><span class="table__sort-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                    <th><button type="button" class="table__sort" data-sort="desc"><span>Active DESC
                            </span><span class="table__sort-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                    <th class="table__cell--action"><button type="button" class="table__filter" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Filter"><span class="table__filter-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                    <path d="M2 3h12L9.5 9v4.5L6.5 12V9L2 3z"></path>
                                </svg></span></button></th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                <tr>
                    <td class="table__cell--checkbox"><input type="checkbox" class="table__checkbox" aria-label="Select row"></td>
                    <td>—</td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>—</td>
                </tr>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Row States

Default, hover (tinted with table-background-row), and selected (uses --color-primary-light, the Saudi-green-50 token).

| --- | --- | --- |

                <tr><td>Hover this row →</td><td class="table__cell--link">Omar Al-Harbi</td><td><span class="status-tag status-tag--sm status-tag--subtle status-tag--neutral"><span class="status-tag__dot"></span><span class="status-tag__label">Inactive</span></span></td></tr>
            </tbody>
        </table>

</div>

## RTL Support

Tables flip cleanly for Arabic and other RTL languages. The selection checkbox column moves to the trailing edge and the action arrow auto-mirrors.

|  | الاسم | الدور | الفريق | الحالة |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | سارة العتيبي | مدير | المنصة | نشط |  |
|  | خالد السبيعي | محرر | المحتوى | قيد المراجعة |  |

```html
<div style="width: 100%;" data-table-interactive="">
    <div class="table-wrapper">
        <table class="table">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th class="table__cell--checkbox"><input type="checkbox" class="table__checkbox" data-role="select-all" aria-label="تحديد الكل"></th>
                    <th><button type="button" class="table__sort" data-sort="asc"><span>الاسم</span><span class="table__sort-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                    <th>الدور</th>
                    <th>الفريق</th>
                    <th>الحالة</th>
                    <th class="table__cell--action"><button type="button" class="table__filter" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="تصفية"><span class="table__filter-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                    <path d="M2 3h12L9.5 9v4.5L6.5 12V9L2 3z"></path>
                                </svg></span></button></th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                <tr>
                    <td class="table__cell--checkbox"><input type="checkbox" class="table__checkbox" aria-label="تحديد الصف"></td>
                    <td class="table__cell--link">سارة العتيبي</td>
                    <td>مدير</td>
                    <td>المنصة</td>
                    <td><span class="status-tag status-tag--sm status-tag--subtle status-tag--success"><span class="status-tag__dot"></span><span class="status-tag__label">نشط</span></span></td>
                    <td class="table__cell--action"><button type="button" class="table__action" aria-label="فتح"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                <path d="M3 8h10M9 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
                            </svg></button></td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td class="table__cell--checkbox"><input type="checkbox" class="table__checkbox" aria-label="تحديد الصف" checked=""></td>
                    <td class="table__cell--link">خالد السبيعي</td>
                    <td>محرر</td>
                    <td>المحتوى</td>
                    <td><span class="status-tag status-tag--sm status-tag--subtle status-tag--warning"><span class="status-tag__dot"></span><span class="status-tag__label">قيد
                                المراجعة</span></span></td>
                    <td class="table__cell--action"><button type="button" class="table__action" aria-label="فتح"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                <path d="M3 8h10M9 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
                            </svg></button></td>
                </tr>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>
```
